channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PGR defende a rejeição de recursos apresentados por defesa de Bolsonaro contra a restrição de visitas
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) supported Justice Alexandre de Moraes in rejecting Bolsonaro's defense appeals to overturn the ban on visits by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to his father, who is under house arrest. The PGR argued that the senator violated the terms of the humanitarian measure by sharing a handwritten letter from Jair Bolsonaro on social media, constituting an abuse of visitation rights and breach of the social media prohibition. The visit suspension, lasting 90 days, remains in effect throughout the 2026 electoral campaign.

item.title: Quem está na frente para presidente? O que dizem pesquisas da última semana
item.description: Recent polls show Lula (PT) leading Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the first-round scenario for the 2026 presidential election. While the percentage gaps vary across surveys, the trend indicates an advantage for the incumbent president. Second-round scenarios were also examined, yielding divergent results depending on the opponent.

item.title: Moraes arquiva ação contra funcionários da Havan por atos antidemocráticos
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes dismissed an investigation into Havan employees over alleged involvement in anti-democratic acts in Rio do Sul (SC) following Lula’s 2022 election victory. The ruling cites insufficient evidence to proceed with the case.

item.title: Quem é Conor Kennedy, marido de Giulia Be que pode ser preso na Rússia
item.description: John Conor Kennedy, husband of Brazilian singer Giulia Be and an attorney, may be arrested in Russia after its justice system authorized his detention on allegations of serving as a mercenary alongside Ukrainian armed forces. He is the son of Robert F. Kennedy Jr., U.S. Secretary of Health, and a grandnephew of John F. Kennedy. The couple married in a private ceremony in Los Angeles in March 2026, with guest lists reportedly including Donald Trump and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Renan Santos ironiza erro no currículo de Flávio
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Mission to the Presidency, mocked the error in Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) resume, which lists Law at USP without completing the course. He pointed out that Flávio's supporters tried to diminish him over his education, yet Flávio's own official resume contains a similar inaccuracy. The comment was made in a press release sent on Wednesday, the 12th.

item.title: Tarcísio rebate fala de Haddad sobre presença de traficante em palco
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas's campaign countered Fernando Haddad's accusation that he lied about Haddad sharing a stage with a drug trafficking leader, releasing photos from a June 2025 event showing Alessandra Moja Cunha, sister of a PCC leader, on stage alongside Haddad — though no interaction between them was recorded. Haddad had claimed he did not know her and that Tarcísio should have arrested her if he knew of her criminal ties.

item.title: Governo Tarcísio aciona STF contra Lula
item.description: The São Paulo state government, led by Tarcísio de Freitas, filed a lawsuit at the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to pressure the federal government into approving a federal guarantee for a R$5.45 billion loan from Banco do Brasil. The state’s Attorney General, Inês Coimbra, claims the Ministry of Finance has taken over 70 days to respond, constituting administrative omission. The move aims to secure funding for state investments, escalating tensions between the state and federal administrations.

item.title: Bruno Guimarães faz de pênalti pelo Arsenal após eliminação do Brasil
item.description: Bruno Guimarães scored his first goal for Arsenal by converting a penalty in a friendly against Como, following his missed penalty in Brazil's World Cup elimination against Norway. Coming on as a substitute, he calmly slotted the third penalty for Arsenal, helping them win 4-3 on penalties. The goal was hailed as a personal and symbolic redemption after his earlier disappointment with the national team.

item.title: Gleisi defende Janja após deputada do PL acionar MPF por caso Discord
item.description: Federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) defended First Lady Janja Lula da Silva after deputy Júlia Zanatta (PL-SC) filed a complaint with the Federal Public Ministry (MPF) over Janja's stance on the Discord case. Gleisi criticized Zanatta's action, saying she is attacking those trying to prevent crimes against children, and stressed that platforms must comply with Brazilian child protection laws. The ANPD had ordered the suspension of live streams on Discord following the death of a 13-year-old girl on the platform.

item.title: Pool de emissoras das Eleições 2026 começa a funcionar em 24 de agosto
item.description: Starting August 24, the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will activate the broadcaster pool for the 2026 General Elections, responsible for receiving media materials and generating the signal for free electoral propaganda. Service will be available from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. in room 501, 5th floor, at the TSE headquarters in Brasília, with detailed information published on the TSE portal on the same date.

item.title: “O diálogo foi restabelecido”, diz Alcolumbre sobre trégua com Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) said dialogue with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) has been restored following their meeting on Wednesday, the 12th. He stated they did not discuss any past STF nomination, saying 'we didn't talk about the past'. The two had been estranged since the Senate rejected a Supreme Court nomination during the previous administration.

item.title: Lula assina decreto que abre mercado livre de energia para consumidores residenciais e pequenos estabelecimentos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a decree opening the free electricity market to low-voltage consumers, starting with small businesses in November 2027 and extending to residential consumers in November 2028. The measure aims to reduce electricity bills by up to 20% for small establishments and establishes a Supplier of Last Resort (SUI) to ensure supply continuity until 2030, after which other entities may assume the role under Aneel regulation. Lula also signed decrees on sustainable aviation fuel, low-emission hydrogen, and carbon capture and storage.

item.title: Governo aproveita texto que amplia gastos em 2026 para sinalizar ajuste nas contas em 2027
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved changes to fiscal rules allowing the Lula government to increase spending in 2026, an election year, while promising to contain expenses in 2027. The adjustment seeks to balance electoral stimulus needs with future fiscal responsibility.

item.title: Totalização dos votos é aberta, auditável e segura, diz TSE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) states that the vote tallying process for the 2026 elections is open, auditable, and secure, with voting beginning at individual polling stations, generation of ballot bulletins, encrypted transmission of data, and authenticity checks before results are consolidated. Parties, candidates, and overseers can monitor all stages, and the system allows for recounts and post-election audits, preserving ballots and digital records. Printed voting was deemed unconstitutional by the STF, and biometrics serve as an additional security layer to verify voter identity.

item.title: Plano de Flávio Bolsonaro deve propor mudanças no funcionamento do STF. Veja quais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) preliminary government plan proposes reforms to the functioning of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), including ending privileged jurisdiction for authorities, limiting individual ministers' monocratic decisions, and imposing a one-year quarantine for former ministers and state secretaries before being appointed to the Court. These changes require congressional approval and reflect a long-standing opposition agenda, amplified by 2025 protests against the arrest of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Governo de SP entra com recurso no STF para destravar empréstimo federal de R$ 5,4 bi para obras
item.description: The São Paulo state government, led by Tarcísio de Freitas, filed a petition with the STF to compel the Federal Ministry of Finance to release a R$ 5.45 billion loan from Banco do Brasil for infrastructure and mobility projects. The issue has become politicized, with Flávio Bolsonaro leveraging it to criticize the federal government, intensifying tensions between state and federal authorities.

item.title: MDB fecha apoio à PEC e pressiona Alcolumbre a despachar 6x1
item.description: The MDB Senate bloc unanimously urged that the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule be processed urgently, increasing pressure on Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The bloc considers the proposal, stalled since May, one of its three top priorities — alongside the Public Security PEC and the legal framework for critical minerals — all delayed due to tensions between Alcolumbre and President Lula. Leader Eduardo Braga stated the MDB supports urgent processing via the CCJ to accelerate deliberation.

item.title: Lula pede a Alcolumbre que faça ‘o possível e o impossível’ para votar o fim da escala 6x1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urged Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to do 'everything possible and impossible' to approve the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, passed by the Chamber in May but stalled in the Senate. Although acknowledging the vote is unlikely before the October elections, Lula renewed his confidence in Alcolumbre after over three months of estrangement, seeking his support for Lula’s 2026 reelection and public endorsement to counter Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy.

item.title: Após terremoto, Brasil atende a pedido da Colômbia e anuncia envio de ajuda humanitária ao país
item.description: Brazil announced the dispatch of humanitarian aid to Colombia following a 7.4-magnitude earthquake that left over 200 dead. The decision came after talks between Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira and his Colombian counterpart Omar Escobar, with the Itamaraty confirming the aid. President Lula also expressed solidarity and offered full government support for rescue and recovery operations.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre não conversaram sobre Messias, diz ministro
item.description: In the meeting between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre on Wednesday (August 12), the possible re-nomination of Attorney General Jorge Messias to the STF was not discussed, as confirmed by Minister José Guimarães. The meeting focused on advancing government priorities in the Senate, including the Public Security PEC and the end of the 6×1 work scale, as well as the MP to eliminate the 'blusinhas' tax. Lula intends to discuss the Messias matter only in a private conversation with Alcolumbre at a later time.

item.title: Comissão inicia análise de redução da maioridade penal sob questionamento de constitucionalidade
item.description: The Special Committee of the Chamber of Deputies elected Deputy Aluisio Mendes (Republicanos-MA) as president and Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) as rapporteur to analyze proposals for reducing the age of criminal responsibility, including PECs establishing full civil and criminal majority at age 16. The rapporteur presented a work plan with five thematic axes and a timeline aiming for a vote in the committee and plenary by December 2026, following the 2028 municipal elections as a potential reference for a popular referendum.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lincoln Gakiya recusou cargo em eventual governo
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that prosecutor Lincoln Gakiya of São Paulo's Gaeco declined an invitation to lead the proposed Ministry of Public Security, which Caiado promises to create if elected. Caiado said he spoke with Gakiya, who refused the offer.

item.title: 'Mente no currículo' e 'constrangedor': adversários criticam Flávio por pós-graduação que não fez
item.description: Opponents criticize Flávio Bolsonaro after a report revealed his official pages listed a non-existent postgraduate degree in Political Sciences at UFRJ. Renan Santos (Missão) called the episode embarrassing and humiliating, while Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) accused him of lying on his resume, comparing it to a doctor falsifying a specialization. Flávio’s campaign claimed the information was due to errors or inaccuracies, possibly sourced from Wikipedia.

item.title: Líder do PT publica foto ao lado de Motta no hospital e diz que está bem após AVC
item.description: Deputy Pedro Uczai (PT-SC), leader of the Workers' Party in the Chamber of Deputies, posted a photo alongside Hugo Motta and Jandira Feghali in a hospital after suffering a stroke on Tuesday. He is conscious, showing good clinical evolution with no cognitive or motor impairment, and received a call from President Lula urging him to prioritize his health to continue leading the bloc and supporting the electoral campaign. The visit took place two days after Motta declared his support for Lula's re-election.

item.title: Quanto Andrea Sorvetão, ex-paquita e candidata a deputada, declarou ao TSE
item.description: Former paquita Andréa Sorvetão, running for federal deputy under the Democratic Christian Party in the 2026 elections, declared assets exceeding BRL 144,000 to the TSE. Her holdings include one-third of an apartment valued at BRL 70,000, 99% of Sevem 7 Music Distribuidora (BRL 49,000), and 50% of Sorvetão Casa de Festas & Eventos (BRL 25,000).

item.title: João Campos vai a Brasília gravar com Lula
item.description: João Campos (PSB), the candidate for governor of Pernambuco and currently trailing Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) in the polls, will travel to Brasília on Thursday to record a video with President Lula (PT). The recording will be aired on free electoral radio and TV time starting on the 28th as part of his campaign strategy.

item.title: TSE fecha o cerco a candidatos de mentira
item.description: The TSE plans to ban the use of avatars and deep fakes in the 2026 electoral campaigns, classifying them as abuse of power subject to disqualification, following Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign use of a virtual replica of Jair Bolsonaro at a party convention. The Court will also debate rules for audio and video in electoral polls to prevent manipulation, having previously blocked a poll that favored the candidate due to induced audiovisual resources. The ruling, based on the case against the Jair Bolsonaro avatar, will set precedents for the entire election, likely resulting in a fine but establishing legal boundaries.

item.title: Bolsonaro intercedeu para que Michelle gravasse com Flávio após crise, dizem aliados
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro intervened to have Michelle Bolsonaro record with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro following a family rift over the PL’s support for Ciro Gomes in Ceará. The meeting, held at the campaign headquarters in Brasília, marked their first in-person encounter since public reconciliation, featuring joint prayer and content creation for social media and electoral propaganda. Despite the unity display, Michelle’s allies say the meeting does not signal deeper campaign involvement or a substantial improvement in their relationship.

item.title: Alcolumbre diz que rusgas foram ignoradas em conversa com Lula e que diálogo está restabelecido
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre said his second meeting with President Lula in a short time restored dialogue between them, setting aside past tensions. He described the meetings as productive and institutional, vital for democracy, and noted the rapprochement began with a dinner at Justice Alexandre de Moraes's home.

item.title: Alcolumbre elogia reunião com Lula: "Importante para a democracia"
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) praised his meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) as institutional and important for democracy, stating that dialogue was restored without addressing past conflicts. Despite the renewed talks, he avoided setting a timeline for voting on the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale — a key Lula priority — and urged caution regarding the rapprochement.

item.title: Câmara aprova projeto de desoneração de combustíveis que prevê ajuste fiscal a partir de 2027
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill allowing extraordinary oil revenues in 2026 to offset tax reductions on fuels, a measure aimed at mitigating the impact of the Iran war on Brazilian fuel prices. The bill, which still requires Senate approval, also includes fiscal adjustments starting in 2027 to address expenditures outside the fiscal framework, such as the health floor and the FCDF. Despite its passage, the bill faced criticism for incorporating so-called 'jabutis' during negotiations, increasing spending in 2026.

item.title: Lulômetro indica tendência de baixa para Lula
item.description: The Lulômetro, a daily tracking poll of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's popularity conducted by Realtime Big Data and O Antagonista, shows that the gap between those who view his government as bad or terrible (37%) and those who see it as good or excellent (30%) reached seven points on April 12. This is the largest negative margin recorded since tracking began, indicating a declining trend in Lula's approval ratings.

item.title: Romeu Zema e Renan Santos criticam Janja após suspensão de lives no Discord
item.description: Presidential candidates Romeu Zema (Novo) and Renan Santos (Missão) criticized the ANPD's suspension of Discord livestreams, linking the decision to public pressure from First Lady Janja da Silva following the suicide of a 13-year-old girl allegedly streamed on the platform. Both argued the move constitutes political censorship, accusing Janja of exploiting the tragedy to silence opponents, with Zema claiming the PT acts arbitrarily and Santos questioning government priorities amid high child mortality rates.

item.title: Prova digital exige mais que um simples print para ter validade na Justiça
item.description: Brazilian courts are raising the bar for digital evidence, rejecting isolated screenshots lacking technical validation or chain of custody. As digital evidence from smartphones and social media grows — especially from WhatsApp, Instagram, and OLX — its ephemeral nature and ease of manipulation challenge judicial acceptance. Cellebrite’s 2026 survey finds 95% of justice professionals consider digital evidence crucial, yet face hurdles in preservation, encryption, and timely analysis.

item.title: Programa de Flávio para mulheres vai defender independência financeira e voucher para creches
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro launches the 'Plan for Brazil to Overcome Backwardness' targeting female voters, proposing to expand women's financial emancipation and increase full-time daycare availability, including vouchers for private institutions when public spots are unavailable. The plan includes 'Women's Centers' offering shelter, legal aid, psychological support, job training, credit access, and electronic monitoring of aggressors under protective orders.

item.title: Aposta do governo para as eleições, 6×1 fica sem data após reunião entre Lula e Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula and Alcolumbre met to restart dialogue but did not set a date for voting on the proposal to end the 6×1 work schedule, a government priority for the 2026 elections. The agenda also included the MP to end the 'blusinhas tax', the Public Security PEC, and the critical minerals bill, aiming to align Planalto priorities with Congress's schedule. The meeting marked a new step in their rapprochement following the tension over the rejected nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, which was not revisited.

item.title: Entrevista: totalização dos votos é processo aberto, auditável e seguro
item.description: Vote tabulation in Brazil is an open, auditable, and secure process, featuring encrypted transmission and private-key verification. The electronic ballot box, domestically developed, ensures decentralized tallying at polling stations, with no evidence of fraud in 30 years of use. TSE’s IT Secretary Júlio Valente emphasizes the system’s engineering as a cornerstone of democratic stability ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio solicita ao STF julgamento de ações sobre Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, Senate opposition leader and coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, urged STF President Minister Edson Fachin to place four Direct Actions of Unconstitutionality (ADIs) challenging the Dosimetry Law on the agenda. The law reduces penalties for the January 8 acts. The actions, under the rapporteurship of Minister Alexandre de Moraes, contest formal and material aspects of the law, including regime progression, concurrence of crimes, and special cause for penalty reduction. Marinho argues the cases are mature for plenary review and that their adjudication will enhance legal security and stability in the criminal justice system.

item.title: Sites oficiais do Senado e da Alerj registram pós-graduação que Flávio Bolsonaro não fez
item.description: Official websites of the Brazilian Federal Senate and the Rio de Janeiro State Legislative Assembly (Alerj) incorrectly state that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a 2026 presidential candidate, holds a postgraduate degree in 'political sciences'. The Alerj biography claims he studied at UFRJ, but no evidence confirms completion. The false information was identified on December 8, 2026.

item.title: “Quem mente no currículo não tem compromisso na hora de governar”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for an error in his curriculum published on the official websites of Alerj and the Senate, which falsely claimed he completed a postgraduate degree in Political Sciences at UFRJ. Caiado stated that those who lie on their resumes lack commitment to govern, questioning the integrity of the presidential candidate.

item.title: Data-limite para apresentar pedidos de registros de candidaturas termina dia 15
item.description: Political parties, federations, and coalitions have until 7 p.m. on August 15 to submit candidacies registration requests via CANDex, as per TSE Resolution No. 23.609/2019. The request does not guarantee approval, which depends on judicial review. The TSE is responsible for judging registration requests for the Presidency.

item.title: Iniciativa popular quer 50% das vagas no Legislativo para mulheres
item.description: A popular initiative proposed by the São Paulo Public Prosecutor's Office and organizations such as Vote Nelas and Black Women Decide seeks to reserve 50% of seats in Brazilian legislative bodies for women, with 25% of that quota allocated to Black women. The movement aims to collect 1.7 million signatures to file a complementary law in the National Congress, arguing that women make up 51.5% of the population but hold only 17% of legislative seats, and that current gender quotas for candidacies are insufficient to achieve equality.

item.title: Câmara instala comissão para debater PEC da redução da maioridade; votação será depois das eleições
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies has installed a special committee to analyze a constitutional amendment (PEC) that would lower the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16 years, with voting scheduled after the October elections. The proposal, led by rapporteur Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) and committee president Aluisio Mendes (Republicanos-MA), amends Article 228 of the Constitution to make individuals aged 16 and older criminally liable as adults. The debate centers on whether the change violates constitutional 'cláusulas pétreas' and international treaties, requiring 308 votes in two rounds for passage in the plenary.

item.title: Lula regulamenta mercado livre de energia para consumidores residenciais; saiba o que muda
item.description: President Lula signed a decree regulating the free energy market for low-voltage consumers, allowing small businesses and industries to choose their energy provider starting November 2027, and residential consumers from November 2028. The measure promises up to 20% reduction in electricity bills for small consumers, with consumer protection via the Supplier of Last Resort (SUI) until 2030, initially managed by distributors. The decree also advances the energy transition, including regulation of the National Low-Carbon Hydrogen Policy.

item.title: Silvia Abravanel declara R$ 47,5 milhões em patrimônio ao registrar candidatura à Câmara no TSE
item.description: Silvia Abravanel, a candidate for federal deputy from São Paulo representing the PSD, declared a net worth of R$ 47.5 million to the TSE, including real estate, financial investments, business stakes, and foreign assets. Notable items include a Santander LCI worth R$ 17.2 million, a residential property valued at R$ 7.5 million, and judicial deposits linked to an ITCMD case. The total reflects her official declaration in the electoral registry.

item.title: Campanhas de Lula e Caiado divergem sobre regulação da IA
item.description: Representatives from Lula's (PT) and Caiado's (PSD) campaigns debated AI regulation and technology policies at Casa JOTA in Brasília. Bimbo (PT) supported the Redata regime as a fiscal incentive for data centers, while Rocha Lima (PSD) criticized the current proposal and advocated for a broader tax regime that does not tax capital expenditures (Capex), citing biogas from Goiás as a sustainable energy alternative for data centers.

item.title: Plano de governo de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe quarentena de 1 ano para indicação ao STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) government plan proposes a one-year quarantine for former ministers and state secretaries before they can be nominated to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), aiming to block immediate appointments like those of Jorge Messias and Flávio Dino by President Lula. The measure would also affect past nominations by Jair Bolsonaro, such as André Mendonça. Flávio states that any government starting in 2027 will need to reform the Judiciary, suggesting the possibility of fixed terms for STF justices.

item.title: Crusoé: Quanto Janja custou até agora no governo Lula
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva's government-related expenses exceeded R$ 117.5 million in 2024, according to the 'Janjômetro' platform created by São Paulo state deputy Guto Zacarias (União Brasil) to track public spending by her office. The figure marks an 86% increase from the previously reported R$ 63 million.

item.title: Lula assina decretos sobre descarbonização e transição energética
item.description: President Lula signed four decrees to accelerate decarbonization and energy transition in Brazil, including rules for carbon capture and storage, sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), and opening the free energy market for low-voltage consumers. The measure will allow small businesses, industries, rural properties, hospitals, and schools to freely choose their electricity provider starting November 2027, with residential consumers gaining access in November 2028, with expectations of lower electricity prices. The decrees also establish a national infrastructure plan for carbon and regulate the National Low-Carbon Hydrogen Policy.

item.title: O silêncio sobre o indicado de Lula para o STF na reunião com Alcolumbre
item.description: In the second meeting between Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, the name of Jorge Messias — Lula’s pick for the STF and the focal point of their recent conflict — was not mentioned. Messias remains Lula’s chosen nominee for the Supreme Court vacancy, despite being rejected by the Senate in April. The article is subscriber-only.
